**Test image analysis:**
- **Affected part**: Stem/petiole (close-up macro shot)
- **Key features**: Dark brown to purplish-brown discoloration/streaking along the stem length; hairy stem trichomes visible; green pods present in background; linear lesion pattern, not discrete spots

**Candidate matching:**
- **Diaporthe** (stem canker): causes dark brown to purple-brown linear cankers along the stem — matches well
- **Phomopsis**: closely related, similar stem lesions but often lighter tan with pycnidia
- **Anthracnose**: dark stem lesions but typically more irregular/sunken

**Reference comparison:**
The Diaporthe reference images show dark brown/purple-brown linear cankers along the stem — the discoloration pattern, color (purple-brown), and the linear/streaking nature along the stem length in the test image closely match Diaporthe stem canker. The macro view shows the characteristic dark streaking on the stem tissue without discrete leaf spots, which is consistent with Diaporthe.
